description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential search is for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

In this pivotal leadership role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, including clinical services, financial performance, and staff development. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of residents, guiding a dedicated team to deliver exceptional care and achieve outstanding outcomes. We are looking for a proactive and compassionate administrator ready to embrace the challenges and rewards of leading a dynamic healthcare environment.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an Administrator in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Proven ability to lead, manage, and motivate a diverse team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Orthopedic (Hand) Surgeon to join a leading medical center in New York City. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated surgeon to provide specialized care for conditions affecting the hand, wrist, and forearm. The role offers a competitive compensation package with a strong emphasis on performance-based bonuses.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about delivering high-quality patient care and possess a proven track record in orthopedic hand surgery. You will be part of a collaborative team, contributing to a facility renowned for its commitment to patient outcomes and advanced medical practices. This position is designed for a surgeon looking for significant earning potential through a bonus-heavy structure.
requirements: Minimum of 5+ years of post-fellowship experience
Experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $400,000 to $500,000 annually, with a significant emphasis on performance-based bonuses.

description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a Certified Dietary Manager. This facility, with 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, is ideally situated on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a charming neighborhood behind the building. You'll enjoy a vibrant work environment just 15 minutes from the beach, complete with two inviting courtyards for residents and staff.

In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of our dietary department, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, nutritious meals that meet the individual needs of our residents. You will be responsible for menu planning, food preparation, inventory management, and maintaining strict sanitation standards. Your leadership will be crucial in managing our dedicated dietary team and ensuring compliance with all relevant health and safety regulations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate and experienced dietary professional to make a significant impact in a supportive and dynamic setting. We are looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and is committed to enhancing the dining experience for our residents.
requirements: Proven experience in food service management, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of therapeutic diets and nutritional requirements for the elderly
Knowledge of state and federal dietary regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
